_readme: One entry per service page. Copy, inclusions and audiences below are drawn from the BINM project docs in Google Drive: 'BINM Website – Service Streams Structure & Targeting Logic', 'EXISTING BUILDINGS | BINM', 'RENOVATIONS AND EXTENSIONS | BINM', the metro location page docs and 'BINM_Keyword_Mapping' (June 2026). `primaryKeyword` and `metaTitle` are reference fields for the SEO team; the generator ignores them.
_urlNote: The 11 URLs here are the live URLs supplied by the client. Five differ from the June 2026 keyword map, which lists /building-and-pest-inspection/, /commercial-building-inspection/, /pre-auction-inspection/, /insurance-assessment/ and /warranty-defect-inspection/. The live URLs win, since every @id is built from them — but confirm the keyword map is updated to match so internal links and tracking do not point at the older slugs.
_verifyNote: building-insurance-assessment is the one entry to check against the live page before publishing. The June keyword map targets that page at insurance valuation and reinstatement cost assessment, while the rest of the BINM material frames insurance work as engineer-led damage and causation assessment for claims. The description below follows the damage-assessment framing; correct it if the live page sells reinstatement valuations.

services.name: Existing Building Inspections
services.metaTitle: Existing Building Inspections | Pre-Purchase, Strata & Defects
services.description: Engineer-led inspections of existing homes, strata properties and commercial buildings, covering general condition, defect and movement investigation, and causation analysis. One inspection by a Chartered Engineer at a standard inspection price, escalatable to an engineering-level or tribunal-ready expert report without a second site visit.
services.serviceOutput: Engineer-led building inspection report, upgradeable to an engineering-level or VCAT-compliant expert report with no second inspection fee.
services.audience: Homeowners, buyers and sellers, strata committees and owners corporations, landlords and investors
items: Strata and body corporate common property inspection
Floor level survey and contour map
Targeted investigation of cracking, water ingress, balconies and retaining walls
Rectification scope of works, cost estimates and post-rectification verification

services.name: Renovation and Extension Inspections
services.description: Engineer-led inspections across renovation and extension projects, from a pre-works condition survey through every construction stage to an 18-month warranty review. Independent oversight focused on the interface between existing structure and new work, where most renovation defects occur.
services.serviceOutput: Stage-by-stage inspection reports, recorded slab and finished-floor baselines, and an 18-month warranty movement and defects review.
services.audience: Homeowners renovating or extending, builders and owner-builders
items: Existing condition (dilapidation) survey of the subject property
Architectural and structural design documentation review
RFI and building surveyor response support
Post-pour slab check with baseline level survey
Structural frame inspection focused on the old/new interface

services.name: New Building Inspections
services.metaTitle: New Build Inspections | Engineer-Led Construction Stage Checks
services.description: Independent engineer-led inspections across the construction of a new home or building, covering the core stage spine from footing pre-pour to practical completion, with optional pre-plaster, waterproofing, lock-up and drone roof checks, movement baselines and an 18-month warranty review.
services.serviceOutput: Stage inspection reports, recorded movement baselines and a practical completion defect list for builder rectification.
services.audience: Homeowners building a new house, owner-builders and small residential developers
items: Slab baseline level survey and finished-floor baseline

services.name: Adjoining Works Protection and Dilapidation Reporting
services.serviceType: Dilapidation survey and adjoining property protection
services.metaTitle: Dilapidation Reports & Adjoining Works Protection | Engineer-Led
services.description: Condition surveys, protection works assessment and construction monitoring for properties adjoining excavation, demolition or construction works. Documented before, during and after the works, so any damage claim is settled against an engineer-recorded baseline rather than recollection.
services.serviceOutput: Pre-works and post-works dilapidation surveys, monitoring records and, where required, an engineering causation report.
services.audience: Owners and builders undertaking boundary-adjacent works, adjoining neighbours, and building surveyors
items: Protection works assessment of proposed methodology, drawings, services and drainage
Protection works documentation support for permit and notice readiness
Level survey and contour baseline with repeat surveys

services.name: Pre-Purchase Building Inspection
services.metaTitle: Pre-Purchase Building Inspection | Chartered Engineer From $495
services.description: Pre-purchase inspection of all accessible areas of the property, reported in line with AS 4349.1 and conducted by a Chartered Engineer rather than a trade-qualified generalist. Covers structure, roof space and covering, subfloor, walls, wet areas, drainage and safety hazards, fully photographed.
services.serviceOutput: AS 4349.1 standard property inspection report with a full photographic record, delivered before exchange.
items: Roof covering and roof space inspection
Internal walls, ceilings, windows and doors
Site drainage and site condition assessment
Engineering-level report upgrade with no second inspection fee

services.name: Strata Inspection Report
services.metaTitle: Strata Inspection Reports | Engineer-Led Common Property Assessment
services.description: Engineer-led inspection of common property for owners corporations, strata committees and buyers of strata-titled property. Covers the building envelope, balcony and balustrade compliance, and structural condition, with a maintenance priority report to inform capital works decisions.
services.serviceOutput: Common property inspection report with a ranked maintenance priority schedule.
services.audience: Owners corporations, strata committees, strata managers and buyers of strata-titled property
items: Structural condition assessment of shared elements
Maintenance priority report for capital works planning
Engineering-level report upgrade for defect claims

services.name: Building Insurance Assessment
services.metaTitle: Building Insurance Assessments | Engineer-Prepared Claim Reports
services.description: Independent engineer-prepared assessment of building damage for insurance purposes, establishing the cause and extent of the damage and the scope of works required to reinstate the building. Prepared by a Chartered Engineer to the standard required for claims and disputed claim proceedings.
services.serviceOutput: Engineer-prepared damage assessment report setting out causation, extent and reinstatement scope.
services.audience: Property owners, landlords, owners corporations and strata managers making an insurance claim
items: Formal engineering opinion for disputed claims

services.name: Building Warranty and Defect Inspection
services.metaTitle: Warranty & Defect Inspections | Engineer-Led Defect Reports
services.description: Defect inspections for owners inside the statutory warranty period, including the 12-month and 18-month warranty milestones when most defects and structural movement first become apparent. Engineer-prepared documentation for builder rectification, insurance claims or tribunal proceedings.
services.serviceOutput: Itemised defect report with causation findings and a rectification scope, escalatable to a VCAT-compliant expert report.
services.audience: Home owners, owners corporations and investors inside the statutory warranty period
items: Handover and practical completion defect inspection
Structural defect identification and causation analysis
Comparison against recorded slab and finished-floor baselines
Rectification scope of works and cost estimates

services.name: Building and Pest Inspection
services.metaTitle: Building & Pest Inspections | AS 4349.1 and AS 4349.3 Combined
services.description: Combined building and timber pest inspection reported against AS 4349.1 and AS 4349.3, two separate standards with separate scopes. Covers building defects alongside termite activity, timber pest damage and the conditions conducive to attack, in one engineer-led visit.
services.serviceOutput: Combined building and timber pest report addressing AS 4349.1 and AS 4349.3.
services.audience: Home buyers, owners and property investors
items: Termite activity and timber pest damage detection

services.name: Commercial Building Inspection
services.metaTitle: Commercial Building Inspections | Engineer-Led Condition Reports
services.description: Engineer-led inspections of commercial, industrial and retail property for purchasers, tenants, landlords and asset owners. Covers building condition, structural assessment, defect identification and retrospective compliance against the National Construction Code and relevant Australian Standards.
services.serviceOutput: Commercial building condition and defect report, with engineering assessment where structural issues are identified.
services.audience: Commercial purchasers, tenants, landlords and asset managers
items: Roof, facade and external envelope inspection
Retrospective compliance assessment against the National Construction Code
Maintenance and capital expenditure planning input

services.name: Pre-Auction Building Inspection
services.description: Building inspection carried out before auction day, with same-week availability, so you can bid knowing the property's defects and repair exposure. Auction purchases are unconditional, which makes inspecting beforehand the only opportunity to find problems.
services.serviceOutput: Pre-auction inspection report delivered ahead of auction day, with a verbal summary available on site.
items: Structural element and major defect assessment
Repair priority guidance to inform bidding
Engineering-level report upgrade with no second inspection fee
